summary: Standards: the Unreleased CHANGELOG entry says meta.schemaVersion of artifacts prune is 1.2 (was 1.1), but the binary built from this tree emits 1.3 (was 1.2): the report's SCHEMA_VERSION is 1.2 and prune carries state in data, so json_out::bumped adds one minor; a success preview printed meta.schemaVersion 1.3, and `canon schema artifacts prune --json` and docs/cli/canon.cli.json say 1.3. Fix the sentence to `1.3` (was `1.2`); the verify figure 1.1 (was 1.0) is right. Blast radius: no check pins the version sentence (artifacts.prune.26/27 look for five substrings only), so a wrong contract version in the release notes passes the release check.
